Question: Four numbers are written in a row. The average of the first two is \(21,\) the average of the middle two is \(26,\) and the average of the last two is \(30.\) What is the average of the first and last of the numbers?
Solution:
The first pair and the last pair together include all four numbers once. Their sums are \(2\cdot21=42\) and \(2\cdot30=60\), so all four numbers add to \(102\).

The middle pair adds to \(2\cdot26=52\). Removing that pair leaves the first and last numbers, whose sum is

\[
102-52=50.
\]

Their average is \(50/2=\boxed{25}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{B}}\). We can find the requested average without determining any individual number.
